nodes.name: RAG Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {"query":"your question"}. Workflow must be Active for the /webhook/rag-query URL to serve. Returns {answer, sources}.

nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Makes this workflow callable as a TOOL by the agentic workflow. Declares one input: query (string). Returns {answer, sources} to the caller.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: EDIT gatewayUrl/qdrantUrl/collection/topK. 'query' is auto-normalized: webhook sends body.query, the agent tool sends query - both land in $('Config').first().json.query.

nodes.name: Embed Query
nodes.notes: Embed the user's question via the OpenVINO Model Server (Embeddings) CUSTOM node -> gateway /v1/embeddings. Same BGE model WF1 used to store chunks (768-dim, Cosine). Returns { embedding, dimensions }.

nodes.name: Qdrant Search
nodes.notes: Semantic search over the vectors WF1 stored. Returns result[] with payload {text, source_file, pg_id, ...}. The 'documents' collection must already exist (768/Cosine) - WF1 upserts but never creates it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const cfg = $('Config').first().json; const q = String(cfg.query || ''); const STOP = new Set(['the','and','for','was','were','are','what','which','who','how','many','much','its','this','that','there','their','have','has','had','from','with','about','any','all','get','tell','show','give','does','did','can','could','would','should','you','your','our','not','but','into','over','under','than','then','when','where','why','been','being','they','them']); const terms = [...new Set((q.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._\/-]{2,}/g) || []))].filter(t => !STOP.has(t)).slice(0, 8); const should = terms.length ? terms.map(t => ({ key: 'text', match: { text: t } })) : [{ key: 'text', match: { text: '__no_terms__' } }]; return JSON.stringify({ filter: { should }, limit: Number(cfg.keywordLimit || 10), with_payload: true }); })() }}

nodes.name: Keyword Search
nodes.notes: KEYWORD arm of hybrid search. BGE embeds an exact ID like 'INV-2024-0891' or a GSTIN almost meaninglessly, so semantic search alone cannot find them - only a literal token match can. Uses Qdrant's full-text payload index on 'text' (create it ONCE: PUT /collections/documents/index {field_name:'text', field_schema:{type:'text', tokenizer:'word', lowercase:true, min_token_len:2}}). onError=continue: if the index is missing this arm returns nothing and the workflow degrades to dense-only rather than failing.

nodes.name: Has Context?
nodes.notes: Retrieved anything? true -> ask the LLM grounded in context; false -> return a clean 'no matching documents' answer without hitting the LLM.

parameters.systemPrompt: You answer questions about the stored documents. Use ONLY the provided context. Cite the source file name(s) in square brackets. If the answer is not in the context, reply that you do not have that information in the stored documents. Do not invent facts.

nodes.name: LLM Answer
nodes.notes: Qwen3-8B via the OpenVINO Model Server (Chat Completion) CUSTOM node -> gateway /v1/chat/completions. Grounded answer from the retrieved context. The node builds the system+user messages, strips <think>, and returns { content }. (Showcases the custom node in WF2; embeddings still use an HTTP node because that op is not yet implemented.)

nodes.name: Webhook Call?
nodes.notes: Was this run started by the HTTP webhook, or called as a tool by the agent? Reads Config.viaWebhook rather than $('RAG Webhook').isExecuted - when the agent calls this workflow the webhook node never runs and is not on the execution path, so referencing it directly throws 'node is unexecuted'. Respond-to-Webhook must only run in the webhook case; a sub-workflow call just returns its data to the caller.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Returns the incoming item {answer, sources} as the webhook's JSON response.

nodes.name: Return to Caller
nodes.notes: Terminal node when called as a tool. Its output {answer, sources} is what the agentic workflow receives.
